limits: Only fixed synthetic cases and exact bytes/errors are qualified; no Android parity, ASR quality, durable access, intent activation or global optimum.
Timing includes opaque dispatch, allocator hooks and Vec destruction. Disabled counting still executes atomic gate loads per allocator hook; call counts differ, so that cost does not cancel.
Elapsed values are instrumented same-binary microbenchmark observations, not normal allocator, process CPU, cycles, WAN or full-engine speed gains.
Requested-byte sums are not bytes copied, allocator usable bytes, live/peak heap or RSS; compiler/allocator allocation elimination may affect observations.
Config/fixture preparation and formatting are excluded; validation and complete request assembly are included for full-builder cases.
Six repetitions per run and two runs are not statistical significance or tail/quality coverage; frequency, power, affinity and other OS activity are uncontrolled.
The old release CLI is deliberately not rebuilt/run; its earlier live result does not qualify this new production encoder.
